what_to_detect: Two or more trigger records for distinct instances of the same triggered ability (one script line on different host objects, or one object holding the ability twice) evaluated against one event, each fired independently.
near_miss: A single instance of that ability evaluated against the event, giving one fired trigger record.

what_to_detect: A card outside the battlefield (hand, graveyard, library) whose computed colours or types differ from what its mana cost and printed type line give, because a characteristic-defining ability applies to it there.
near_miss: A card outside the battlefield with no characteristic-defining ability, whose computed colours match its mana cost.
record_fields: state.entities[].colors (computed post-layer; hand cards in snapshot tier 4)

what_to_detect: A trigger whose ability states the zone it functions from (TriggerZones$ naming a zone other than the battlefield) evaluated and fired while its source is in that zone.
near_miss: Such a zone-restricted trigger evaluated while its source is in that zone and not fired (a source outside the stated zone is never evaluated, so writes no record).

what_to_detect: A spell candidate offered through an alternative cost its own card allows (an AlternativeCost static of the card) that is affordable by that cost.
near_miss: A spell candidate offered through such an alternative cost that is not affordable.

what_to_detect: A spell candidate whose cost is modified by its own cost-modifying ability (a ReduceCost or RaiseCost static of the card itself), so its cost_after_adjustment differs from its mana cost.
near_miss: A spell candidate with such an ability whose adjusted cost equals its mana cost.

what_to_detect: A spell candidate in a zone other than hand (exile, graveyard, library) that passes the zone check because the card's own ability permits casting it from there.
near_miss: A spell candidate in a non-hand zone that fails the zone check.

what_to_detect: A spell with a can't-be-countered ability that a counter effect targeted, whose own cost half records outcome resolved.
near_miss: A spell without that ability that a counter effect targeted, whose cost half records outcome countered.
record_fields: the Counter resolution's state.refs.targets naming the spell
the Counter effect half's events (no zone_change moving the target off the stack)

what_to_detect: A resolution that would put counters on a permanent with a can't-have-counters ability (a CantPutCounter static) and puts none on it: no counter_change event names that permanent. Forge checks the static in Card.canReceiveCounters, not as a replacement, so no rewrite record carries it.
near_miss: A counter-placing resolution whose target has no such ability and receives the counters (a counter_change event names it).

what_to_detect: An activated ability of a card outside the battlefield (hand, graveyard, exile) whose cost can be paid only there, passing the zone check in that zone.
near_miss: The same kind of activated-ability candidate in a zone where it fails the zone check.

what_to_detect: An activated ability whose cost or effect moves its own card out of a particular zone, passing the zone check while the card is in that zone.
near_miss: Such an ability's candidate while its card is in another zone, failing the zone check.

what_to_detect: A continuous record whose acting static belongs to an emblem (a command-zone object) and contributes to objects on the battlefield.
near_miss: A command-zone static that applies and contributes nothing to an object outside its affected set.

what_to_detect: An activated or triggered ability that resolves (cost-half outcome resolved) after its source has left the zone it was in, using last known information.
near_miss: An activated or triggered ability that resolves while its source is still in its zone.

what_to_detect: An activated or triggered ability on the stack (not a spell) that resolves; abilities can be countered only by effects that specifically counter abilities.
near_miss: An activated or triggered ability countered by an ability-countering effect (cost-half outcome countered).
record_fields: acting line kind (activated or trigger, from the sidecar)

what_to_detect: An object affected by two or more effects that add and remove the same ability, carrying the ability exactly when the adding effect is the more recent.
near_miss: The same pair of effects with the removing effect more recent, the object lacking the ability.

what_to_detect: A static whose condition reads an object's abilities (creatures with no abilities) still contributing to an object whose characteristic an effect set (colour, type) without granting it an ability.
near_miss: The same static contributing nothing to an object an effect granted an ability to.
